Example News

New ferry schedule starts Monday

Transport · 9 November

Ferries will leave the harbor every twenty minutes during the morning rush, and every hour after nine in the evening.

Lighthouse reopens to visitors

Culture · 8 November

After two years of repairs the lighthouse at the north end of the harbor welcomes visitors again, with a small museum on the ground floor.

Market moves indoors for winter

Community · 7 November

The Saturday market leaves the quay for the old warehouse by the harbor until March. Stalls open at eight.

Weather: wind and rain

Weather · 6 November

Strong westerly winds are expected through Thursday. Small boats should stay in the harbor, and the coastal path may close at high tide.

Swimming club celebrates fifty years

Sport · 5 November

The club that started with six members swimming across the harbor each New Year's Day now counts more than three hundred.
